name: 7 Wonders Duel
summary: Two-player competitive city-building and drafting race where players gather resources, military and science to win instantly or on points.
rules_text: Players draft 4 wonders each, then play 3 ages. Each age has a pyramid of face-up and face-down cards with 3 cards removed unseen. On your turn take one exposed card: either build it paying its resource cost, discard it for coins, or use it to build a wonder paying the wonder cost. Resources you produce reduce costs; missing resources can be bought for 2 coins plus 1 per resource opponent produces. Resources chains give free builds. Red cards move the military track toward opponent; reaching the end wins instantly and inflicts coin loss along the way. Pairs of matching green science symbols let you take a random progress token; 6 different symbols wins instantly. After 3 pyramids, if no instant win, player with most victory points from cards, wonders, coins and progress tokens wins.
rating_reason: Draft duel with hidden picks, perfect turn-based strategic fit
